title: Can LLMs Understand the Impact of Trauma? Costs and Benefits of LLMs Coding the Interviews of Firearm Violence Survivors

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing LLM refusal rates, output validity, and fixation on colloquialisms when prompting the models to perform inductive qualitative coding on interview transcripts containing African American English (AAE).

Evaluating narrative erasure, stereotyping, and disproportionate safety guardrail triggers (refusals) when prompting LLMs to code the traumatic lived experiences of young Black men surviving firearm violence, comparing machine outputs against those of human qualitative coders.
